notes.title: Patch Notes for Crimson Rite – Hotfix (Version 1.0.4)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where collected maps and documents would not load properly after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed an issue where if a chest on the ground floor was already unlocked, the character would freeze when trying to reopen it after loading the saved game.
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu from the pause menu would not function correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the volume setting for sound effects did not work as intended.
[/list]
